verdict.rationale: The only AI capability in the evidence is AI-powered creation of meeting minutes for record keeping. That is document generation, an adjacent feature, not AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The custom licenses-and-permits summary and the personalized dashboard are not described as AI-driven insights. The axis applies to a business-services SaaS, but nothing in the pack shows this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
